description: This file defines a Swing UI component 'SizeSelectorPanel' that displays a grid of selectable elements, allowing users to select a size by clicking on the grid. It manages rendering and user interactions for size selection within the application.

classes.name: SizeSelectorPanel
classes.description: A JPanel subclass providing a grid-based size selection UI with interactive elements.

classes.name: SizeSelectorPanel.Element
classes.description: An inner class representing individual selectable elements within the SizeSelectorPanel grid.

methods.name: SizeSelectorPanel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grid layout, creates elements, and sets up mouse interaction.

methods.name: Element.getPreferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size of the element for layout purposes.

methods.name: Element.paint
methods.description: Custom rendering for each element, drawing an oval with color indicating selection state.
